text:
maria: Heads up — planning a night-window rollout for the new kernel+quant bundle to US-West. Intend to stagger by thermal tier (cold -> warm -> hot) to avoid saturating hot racks. Not starting full traffic yet, want buy-in on rollback criteria and release notes edit.

alex: 👍 I pushed the bundle to staging. One packaging quirk: checksum format changed in build 3.2.0 -> some older deploy agents reject it. I have a repack patch ready.

deploy-bot: preflight-check FAILED on node macaron-13 (checksum-mismatch).
```
ERR: artifact checksum mismatch: expected 0x7a1b2c got 0x4f3d11
agent: rejecting bundle v3.2.0-quant
```

sam: how long to repack + re-run staging smoke? I can run the quick perf + correctness suite.

alex: repack + sign takes ~12m. full perf smoke (quick) ~30–40m. I can trigger after repack.

jin: agree on tiered rollout. Proposal: canary 5% on cold tier nodes (non-thermal-hot), wait 15m, then 20% warm, wait 20m, then remainder on hot. Pin timeline: if any stage trips rollback criteria, pin to previous kernel globally for the night window.

maria: rollback criteria propose:
- error-rate (5xx or model-serve errors) > 0.5% sustained over 10m OR
- p99 latency regression > 25% over baseline for 10m OR
- KV cache eviction rate spike > 2x baseline AND correlated with tail errors

sam: +1. Also add a data-quality check: prompt-output regression on our golden prompts (run during canary). If >3 mismatches, fail.

alex: repack done, pushed v3.2.0-quant+sig. Triggering deploybot to staging now.

deploy-bot: staging deploy started: bundle v3.2.0-quant+sig -> staging. smoke-checks running.
```
smoke: perf: p50=22ms p99=185ms errors=0.02%
smoke: golden-check: 1/120 mismatches (threshold 3)
```

sam: looks clean. I'll run the extended golden set while you validate metrics. tagging @maria for release notes.

maria: release-notes: add entry for kernel+quant 3.2.0 — note packaging checksum fix, staggered thermal rollout, rollback criteria. Also document the manual pin command and TTL. Draft link?

release-notes-bot: Draft created: https://docs.internal/releases/drafts/3.2.0-quant — added sections: Known Issues, Rollback Steps, Safety Windows.

jin: operational checklist posted to ops-runbook channel. Key commands:
```
# pin current kernel in region
redwoodctl runtime pin --region us-west --kernel sha=abcdef --ttl 2h --reason "night rollback"
# force rollback to previous bundle globally
redwoodctl deploy rollback --bundle v3.1.8 --confirm
```

maria: decision: proceed with tiered rollout tonight. Canary (5%) to cold tier at 02:30 PST. Sam run golden checks during 02:30-03:00. jin/sre to watch p99 and error-rate dashboards. If criteria hit, we execute pin command (alex to have pinned sha ready). Release notes draft updated — will add final blurb after canary results.

alex: pinned sha ready: abcdef (v3.1.8). I'll stand by.

sam: I'll be online for the window. Will post quick summary after canary. :eyes:

deploy-bot: rollout started: us-west cold-tier canary 5% -> metrics watcher set (p99, error-rate, kv-evict).

maria: Thanks team. If canary good, we follow jin's stagger schedule. If anything odd — pin and notify #eng-runtime and #oncall.

sam: canary complete — metrics stable: error-rate 0.03%, p99 +4% vs baseline, golden-check 0/120 mismatches. Proceeding to warm-tier 20% in 10m.

jin: warming warm-tier now. monitoring.

deploy-bot: warm-tier rollout 20% started.

alex: noted. I'm watching agent logs for checksum rejects across node types (should be none after repack).

maria: warm-tier stable after 20m. no regressions. Proceed to hot-tier in a 30m gradual ramp with a 10% increment every 5m.

deploy-bot: hot-tier ramp start: +10% -> +10% -> +10% until full.

sam: midway hot-tier (30%) — slight p99 bump to +18%, error-rate 0.15%. still within thresholds. golden-check run passing.

jin: continuing watch. If p99 crosses +25% or errors >0.5% for 10m we pin.

maria: final note for release notes: add troubleshooting steps for checksum mismatch (how to re-sign, where to fetch signed artifacts) and link to runbook. I'll finish the blurb and publish once hot-tier hits 100%.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: bundle v3.2.0-quant+sig deployed to us-west. no automated rollbacks performed.

maria: publishing release notes now. Thanks all — logging postmortem checklist in #eng-runtime for tomorrow (small item: ensure older deploy agents are compatible or auto-upgrade). :white_check_mark:
